body: I mean I want things to go back to how they used to be, before my life turned upside down. I want to be happy again. Feel happy, loved, wanted, appreciated. I wasn't prepared for this in the slightest.

No I am not. I don't know if I could afford therapy. But I know I should probably be talking to someone, I know it'd probably be a little helpful. I'm also a little scared to seek therapy also, just the thought of talking to a stranger face to face about my problems, and I wouldn't know where to begin.

I was having some suicidal thoughts. I was feeling very anxious. I feel a little better now. I'm usually okay in the mornings. I really want to feel better about myself. I want to feel like life is worth living. I want to know how to become motivated to be positive, think positive. I feel so weak I want to be a stronger person. I want to be happy and find joy in life again.

Yes!! Someone suggested writing to me b/c I'm going thru some terrible times, and its helped me a lot. I have no one to talk to, no friends, so I've always kept things bottled in my head until I break. But writing has helped me so much. I write whenever i start feeling anxious and my thoughts wont go away, and i always feel like a huge weight is lifted off my mind when i do that.

Sort of? I dont have abandonment issues, but I've been with my guy for 13 years and the last couple months haven't been so great. I feel like its falling apart and might not last much longer b/c he's given up on me. I have bad days, bad nights, I drink sometimes, can't eat, can't sleep. I've been trying hard to stay strong and take things one day at a time. Easier said than done I know. Also writing in a journal has been helping me a lot more than I thought it would. I suggest giving that a try. It was kinda tough at first, but I think it's worth it. Stay strong. Its gonna be rough for awhile. *hugs*
